run_Demo_localize: run the Demo class localize method to predict camera position and yaw from an image and map canvas
create_Demo_instance: create a Demo instance that loads a pretrained OrienterNet model for visual localization inference
run_ImageCalibrator: run the ImageCalibrator class to estimate camera roll, pitch, and focal length from an RGB image
parse_location_prior: parse a location prior from EXIF metadata, explicit lat/lon coordinates, or a geocoded address string
run_Demo_read_input_image: run the Demo read_input_image method to load an image, extract EXIF, calibrate camera, and compute a bounding box
